items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: He was a French boy... another colored boy, a French boy, and he understood the word 'Musician,' and he saw an instrument, and he saw he has a good chance on me, you know. And he came up and asked the man what he wanted.

ctx.x: So that was how, the relationship with the --
The piano. Yes, that's why I have it. He was a French boy.
